intended_object: The corestriction of a morphism φ : P → M of sheaves of modules to a sub-sheaf of modules N ⊆ M, when all of φ's sections lie in N. This is the factorization of φ through the inclusion N ↪ M, given by its universal property. Inferred from the docstring and the module header.
explanation: The sheaf version wraps the presheaf construction `TauCeti.PresheafOfModules.liftToSubmodule` applied to φ.val. A morphism of sheaves of modules is by definition a morphism of the underlying presheaves, so this is enough. The presheaf version sends each open set U to `codRestrict` of φ_U into N(U). Naturality follows from the naturality of φ and R-linearity from the linearity of φ_U, and `PresheafOfModules.homMk` assembles the pieces. The hypothesis (every section φ_U(s) lies in N(U)) is exactly the condition for factoring through the subobject. The companion lemma `liftToSubmodule_ι` confirms that composing with the inclusion gives back φ. The setting is Mathlib's general one: any site, any sheaf of rings, any sheaves of modules. Mathlib's `Sheaf/Submodule.lean` and `Presheaf/Submodule.lean` only provide `toSheafOfModules`, `ι` and the order on submodules, with no such lift, so there is no Mathlib counterpart.
